Job Description
 We are looking for a Murex Business Analyst to join our team of bright thinkers and doers. You’ll use your problem-solving creativity to figure out our client’s most complex and challenging problems across different industries. We are on a mission to transform the world, and you will be instrumental in shaping how we do it with your ideas, thoughts, and solutions.
Experienced Business Analyst with strong expertise in Front Office trade lifecycle and commodities trading. Skilled in bridging business and technology teams to deliver robust trade processing, integration, and P&L solutions across commodity asset classes.
Responsibilities:
 Gather, analyze, and document business requirements for
 commodity trading workflows.
 Collaborate with traders, quantitative analysts, operations, and IT teams to
 deliver Murex MX.3 solutions.
 Design and support trade integration between upstream trading platforms and
 Murex using MxML, FIX, FpML, REST APIs, XML, and messaging technologies.
Analyze and troubleshoot trade flow issues, interface failures, position breaks,
and P&L discrepancies.
 Support end-to-end trade lifecycle management, including trade capture,
 validation, enrichment, valuation, and settlement.
 Work with market data, static data, and reference data required for commodity
 pricing and valuation.
 Perform functional testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), and production
 validation for new enhancements and releases.
 Support daily Front Office operations by investigating trade exceptions, position
 mismatches, and valuation issues.
 Coordinate with development teams to define functional specifications and
 ensure successful implementation of business requirements.
 Produce business requirement documents (BRDs), functional specifications
 (FSDs), process flows, and test cases
Skills and Experience:
 Murex MX.3 Front Office
 Trade Integration & Interface Design
 Commodity Trade Lifecycle
 Front Office P&L & Mark-to-Market (MTM)
 Position Management & P&L Explain
 Commodity Products: Futures, Forwards, Swaps, Options
 Market Data & Static Data Management
 MxML, FIX, FpML, REST APIs, XML, JSON
 SQL, Oracle, Unix/Linux
 Agile/Scrum, JIRA, Confluence
 Strong stakeholder management and communication skill
 Additional Information
 Besides an exciting job, here s what you can expect:
A fast-paced tech environment
Continuous growth & learning
Open feedback culture
Room for own initiative & ideas
Transparency about results & strategy
Recognition & reward for hard work
Working with a flexible schedule 
Medical subscription
Meal tickets
Extra vacation days - starting with 25 vacation days
Many others perks
 Company Description
 Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner supporting established organizations in achieving a future, digitally enabled state, both in how they operate and how they deliver value to their customers. Our approach integrates strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and creative problem-solving to deliver measurable business outcomes.
